## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag needs to read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because the project's cli-flags rule requires this for every new flag under `cli/` so CI can set options through the environment.

## Changes
This PR adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option to `cli/main.py`. `collect()` uses it to skip files whose base name matches any pattern and logs each skipped path. The PR also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds parser, `collect`, and end-to-end archive tests plus a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and runs `archive src`, `.log` files are still archived, because the flag is declared with `default=[]` and never reads the environment. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that configure the archive through the environment cannot exclude files, so their archives contain unwanted files. — Fix: Set the default by splitting `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE", "")` on a separator you choose and document. Note that `action="append"` adds command-line patterns to that default list rather than replacing it. Document the variable in `docs/flags.md:7`.
